ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Manage-bde.wsf Abuse To Proxy Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential abuse of the "manage-bde.wsf" script as a LOLBIN to proxy execution

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "wscript\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*manage\\-bde\\\.wsf.*")) OR (((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*manage\\-bde\\\.wsf.*")) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$")))
